title: AI capability timeline (2012-2026) - what changed, per branch (LLMs are one of them)
source: Public record: model releases + benchmark milestones across vision, RL, language, multimodal, diffusion, agents, and science. Chronology overlay (structural; no financial-core edges). TAXONOMY: organized by BRANCH, not conflated into 'AI = LLM' - each branch has its own capability arc. HONESTY: releases/dates/benchmarks = fact; 'reasoning'/'agentic'/'AGI-adjacent' labels = marketing-laden, graded; capability claims are provider-reported unless independently benchmarked.

edges.notes: VISION branch arc: AlexNet (2012) -> ResNet (2015) -> object detection/segmentation -> near-saturated ImageNet; vision was where deep learning first became superhuman, years before language (fact).

GENERATIVE-IMAGE branch: GANs (2014) -> diffusion (DDPM 2020) -> DALL-E/Stable Diffusion/Midjourney (2022) -> video (Sora-class, 2024-26); a distinct branch from LLMs that later fused into multimodal systems (fact).

LANGUAGE->MULTIMODAL arc: GPT-2 (2019) -> GPT-3 (2020, few-shot) -> ChatGPT (2022) -> GPT-4/Claude/Gemini (2023, multimodal) -> 2024-26 'reasoning' models (o-series/R1) + long context; capability jumps are real but 'reasoning'/'AGI' labels are provider framing (fact of releases; label claims graded).

2024-2026 shift to AGENTS: tool-use + computer-use + multi-step autonomy (coding agents, browser agents); capability is uneven + benchmark-gamed, and reliability at long horizons remains the open problem (fact of the shift; autonomy claims graded/reported).
RL feeds agents twice: RLHF/RLAIF aligned the LLMs, and RL-on-verifiable-rewards drives the 2025-26 'reasoning' training - the RL branch and the language branch converging (fact).

SCIENCE branch keeps advancing OUTSIDE the LLM race: AlphaFold3 (2024) -> biology/materials/weather models -> the domains where non-LLM AI is furthest ahead; a reminder the capability frontier is plural (fact; taxonomy point).

EFFICIENCY inflection (2025-26): DeepSeek R1 + the open-weight wave showed frontier-adjacent capability at a fraction of the cost - shifting the arc from pure-scale to efficiency (fact; cf fin-ai-efficiency-counter-thesis).
